class.label: Vault strategy routes deposits using Curve get_virtual_price / pool balances under flash-loan skew

remediation.summary: Do not use Curve pool balances or get_virtual_price as the routing decision input for vault rebalancing. Snapshot expected exchange rates from a manipulation-resistant oracle (Chainlink, robust TWAP) and revert if observed slippage exceeds a tight bound. Cap the strategy's per-block movement to limit damage from any single flash-loan.
